newsitem.title: UK: Chelsfield shares up on property deal.
newsitem.headline: Chelsfield shares up on property deal.

text.p: Shares in property developer Chelsfield Plc rose on Wednesday as the company confirmed details of deals that pave the way for the development of a large site near Paddington station in the west of London.
The stock was up 5-1/2p at 268 in volume of 397,300 shares.

Chelsfield said it had raised 25.5 million stg from the sale of two acres of the site to Frogmore Estates and from a settlement over access rights with the Metropole Hotel, some of which proceeds will go towards financing the development.
